title: WaterSound 73 S Founders Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private Deeded Beach Access- Located in a secure, gated community with on-site security- Steps from the beach- Directly across from Dunesider pool- Gulf views- 5 adult bikes- Outdoor shower- Lookout tower- Access to neighborhood pools- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout - This property come with 3 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: Just 3 doors down from the beach and directly across the Dunesider pool, this beautiful Watersound home is newly updated and in the perfect location! This house sleeps 12 and has 5 bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms, including a carriage house.The first floor opens up to a recently renovated kitchen and living area featuring stainless steel appliances and seating for 8 at the dining table. It also opens up to a courtyard and veranda in the backyard. The primary bedroom is down the hall which has a king bed and en suite bathroom with a separate soaking tub and walk-in shower. An additional living room is upstairs as well as 3 more guest rooms, each with its own bathroom. The first room has a queen bed and the others have kings. There is also access via a spiral staircase to the lookout tower with direct Gulf views.The carriage house has a king bed and twin trundle bed to fit 4 additional guests. It has its own bathroom and washer and dryer as well. Guest can enjoy 5 adult bikes and parking for 3 vehicles. Don't miss your chance to book this beautiful home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and TubSECOND FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyCARRIAGE HOUSE:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Twin Day Bed and King Trundle Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyIMPORTANT INFORMATION *No Smoking*HOA regulations do not allow for guest Low-Speed Vehicle rentals. Additionally, bringing your own Low-Speed Vehicle onto the property is prohibited.*This is a peaceful community. To ensure everyone's enjoyment, weddings, parties, gatherings exceeding a reasonable number of guests, and guests of guests are strictly prohibited. Violation of this policy may result in immediate removal from the property, forfeiture of any remaining rental fees, and potential fines from the HOA, community, and 360 Blue.* To ensure a comfortable stay for all guests, pets are not permitted on the property. Please note that any damage caused by pets will be the guest's responsibility.
